meta.title: Two bids on two lines: award both lines to B; approver approves without a remark
gaps: The required closed RFQ state with two line items and two vendor bids (A and B).
Allocating both lines to Vendor B and verifying the expected amounts and total of 1,200.
Creating and submitting the specified two-line award proposal.
Signing in as the approver and approving without a remark.
Verifying the refusal message "Remark is necessary for approval" and that the proposal remains pending.
